# nlohmann_json vendored copy

This directory contains the official single-header amalgamation of
[`nlohmann/json`](https://github.com/nlohmann/json), used for reading/writing
JSON (e.g. serialization) in Kotte.

- Upstream version: `v3.12.0`
- Retrieved: 2026-11-12
- Local modifications: none (file is used as published upstream).
- License: MIT; see [`LICENSE.MIT`](LICENSE.MIT)

The header is intentionally pinned. Update it from upstream as a reviewed
dependency change rather than editing it locally. To upgrade, replace
`include/nlohmann/json.hpp` with the `json.hpp` asset from the desired
[release](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases).
